summary: Implemented Git checkpoint and dirty-state directive compilation for S02T06. Expanded git.checkpoint-required data to include typed Git root state, scoped changed paths, collaboration dirty paths, blocking dirty paths, untracked paths, protected-branch caveats, no-repo-change booleans, no-commit reasons, out-of-scope notes, last commit SHA, and repository-changed status. Added gitDirectiveDataByRegistryId and compileGitAgentDirectiveBundle and reused the typed Git data from closeout/summary compilation.
